correctness.rationale: For d<=2 the ternary dependence relation is universal, leaving pure equality, which FO^3 divides into two sizes 2 and >=3. For d>=3 a three-pebble invariant preserves zero flags, six pair-states and triple dependence. After moving one pebble only two anchors remain; the exact support extension table for independent anchors is 1,1,1,q-2,q-2,(q-1)^2,q^d-q^2, and parallel-anchor cases similarly have possible q-2 and q-3 terms. Positivity depends only on q=2, q=3, q>=4 and d>=3, yielding an unbounded-depth Duplicator back-and-forth. Three-variable formulas define zero and parallelism using universal D and separate the three q-classes. Fresh direct finite-field anchor enumeration verified all supports at q,d=(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(3,4),(5,3), including q=2,3,>=4 boundary cases; the actual all-d proof comes from symbolic extension availability.
